goal.objective: Federate required StegVerse repositories into the single canonical heartbeat using normalized repository heartbeat manifests, freshness/dependency semantics, fail-closed coverage, and an inspectable ecosystem topology receipt without creating per-repository schedulers.
success_predicates: Every required critical repository in control/repo-heartbeat-federation.json publishes a valid normalized manifest.
Every required manifest is fresh and identity-bound to the expected organization/repository.
Control/runtime/service manifests carry commit_sha and runtime_id.
Required dependency loss propagates to dependent repository status.
Missing, stale, invalid or failed required repositories fail closed.
A heartbeat-owned worker emits an inspectable topology hash and coverage receipt.
Credential authority remains TV/TVC and github_token_required remains false.
failure_predicates: A missing or stale required repository is treated as healthy.
A repository manifest grants execution or credential authority.
A second heartbeat or per-repository scheduler becomes federation authority.
GitHub token availability becomes a production liveness requirement.
Dependency loss is hidden from dependent repository state.

task.derivation_reason: Organization-level federation exists, but repository/node enrollment, freshness, dependency-loss propagation, and ecosystem-wide coverage proof are not established.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted heartbeat while required repository coverage is incomplete or changed

completion.next_authorized_action: Admit the worker on the single resident heartbeat, emit initial fail-closed coverage, then enroll missing required repositories using the normalized manifest adapter contract without installing independent schedulers.
terminal_when: All required repository manifests are present and valid
All required repository manifests are fresh
No required repository is FAILED, BLOCKED, RETIRED or dependency-blocked
